name: mentor
description: Keep hold of what a coding agent does to your code. It works on its own, and stops at the end of each step of its plan until you have seen what the step changed, where it fits and what it can break. Ask which type or function to use in plain words, and get any symbol's card, the package map and the path a call takes, all from the compiler's view of the code, on your machine.

settings.label: Open Mentor in
settings.description: A window you can move, a tab of the bottom panel, or the sidebar, where its button then stays.

settings.label: Connect the agent
settings.description: On: Mentor connects the agent for the open folder and stops it after each step of its plan until you approve. Off: the agent works without Mentor.

settings.label: Approve the plan first
settings.description: The agent shows its plan and waits for you before it changes code.

settings.label: Files per step
settings.description: A step that changes more files than this stops for review first. 0: no limit.

settings.label: Show use counts in code
settings.description: A line above each type and function with its uses and tests. Click it for details.

settings.label: Skip files
settings.description: Globs to leave out, comma-separated, such as gen/**, *_mock.go. vendor and testdata are always skipped.

settings.label: Build tags
settings.description: Read the code with these Go build tags, such as integration.

settings.label: Search by meaning
settings.description: Also find code by meaning, with a local Ollama. Nothing leaves your machine.

settings.label: Ollama model
settings.description: An embedding model Ollama has pulled, such as nomic-embed-text.
